settings.heading: Diagnostic Clarification Evaluations
settings.subheading: Diagnostic clarification evaluations are designed to provide a more complete understanding when symptoms feel complex, overlapping, longstanding, or difficult to explain through a brief clinical conversation alone. At Center for Balanced Living, these evaluations are completed with clinical care, depth, and attention to the whole person. The goal is not simply to assign a diagnosis, but to understand what may be contributing to emotional distress, behavioral patterns, interpersonal challenges, cognitive concerns, developmental questions, or treatment uncertainty.

settings.title: People whose symptoms overlap across several conditions

settings.heading: Request a Diagnostic Evaluation
settings.body: Tell us a little about what you are seeking clarity on, and we will guide you through the next step. We usually reach out within 24-48 hours.
settings.disclaimer: This form is not intended for emergencies or urgent mental health concerns. If you are experiencing an emergency, call 911 or go to your nearest emergency room.
